title: Kiwi's Plushies!
description: Collect plushies of your favourite mobs!
body:
This mod adds a plushie block of every minecraft mob up to the Pretty Scary Update, with more coming in the future!

## **Obtaining In Survival:**

### **Craftable:**
- Iron Golem, Snow Golem

### **Drops on Death:**
- Chicken (unobtainable (I forgot to add it's loot table lol))
- Creeper, Skeleton, Spider, Zombie, Zombified Piglin (0.05)
- Blaze, Cave Spider, Cow, Enderman, Ghast, Magma Cube, Pig, Slime, Witch, Wither Skeleton, Zombie Villager (0.1)
- Mooshroom, Silverfish, Squid (0.2)
- Ender Dragon, Wither

### **Drops When Hunting:**
- Wolf (1.3)

### **Found in Chests:**
- Ocelot, Bat

### **Traded/Bartered:**
- Villager

### **Other:**
- Sheep (0.1)

## Known Issues and Plans:
- IMPORTANT: When updating from version 1.0 to 1.1+, any plushies you had acquired on version 1.0 will be lost. This is because the namespace ID has changed.
- There are no known issues! Let me know if you find any or have suggestions!
- All Vanilla mobs are planned to be added in order of their release
